ceu: ✦ The opposition between the Sun and Pluto

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between romance and friendships. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between family and your career. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between conversations and your horizons. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between money and intimacy. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your image and relationships. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your inner life and routine. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between friendships and romance. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your career and family. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between your horizons and conversations. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between intimacy and money. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between relationships and your image. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Family and home take priority. A simple gesture of care has a very big effect today.
The opposition between the Sun and Pluto creates some tension between routine and your inner life. Protect your peace and choose the battles worth fighting.
s.d: Make a family recipe and share it.
